description: This file declares the API for the system timer driver used in the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for setting timeouts, announcing elapsed ticks, and retrieving cycle counters.

methods.name: sys_clock_set_timeout
methods.description: Sets the system clock timeout in ticks and indicates if the system is about to enter idle state.

methods.name: sys_clock_idle_exit
methods.description: Notifies the timer driver that the system is exiting idle mode.

methods.name: sys_clock_announce
methods.description: Announces that a certain number of ticks have elapsed since the last call.

methods.name: sys_clock_elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of ticks elapsed since the last announcement.

methods.name: sys_clock_disable
methods.description: Disables the system timer if supported.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns the current 32-bit hardware cycle count.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_64
methods.description: Returns the current 64-bit hardware cycle count, if supported.
